notes.title: Item drops patch
notes.content:
Hello All!

1. This patch adds inventory items and drops.

2. I am testing a bundle store for my games, where you will be able to find limited time offers with keys, if you would like to take a look, just go to: 

https://anpa.us/store/upload/

3. If you would like to request custom achievement, you can now do so through the store: 
https://anpa.us/store/upload/index.php?route=product/product&product_id=54

Enjoy

ANPA.US

notes.title: Update Patch 2500819
notes.content:
Hey People

This updates fixes some issues with main menu controls, adds multiplayer mode and fixing other bugs that were reported. 

I hope this will improve the overall gameplay experience. 

Thank you for your support.

Cheers 

ANPA.US
